name: cg_market_global
description:
Whole-market cryptocurrency statistics from CoinGecko (global).
Returns {data: {active_cryptocurrencies, markets, total_market_cap: {currency: value}, total_volume: {...}, market_cap_percentage: {btc, eth, ...} (dominance in percent), market_cap_change_percentage_24h_usd, updated_at}}.
Inputs: none.
For DeFi only use cg_defi_global; per category cg_coin_categories_market.
